In 1922 he won the Club Mile Championship, a win he repeated the following year, and succeeded in taking the Surrey County Championship at the distance also In the 1923 7 miles Club Cross-Country Championship Mick finished second to Jimmy Flatt; but in 1924 he won the event from A.E.

In 1927 we again qualified, but in the relay itself we suffered grave disappointment for we were never nearer than ninth, and eventually finished 17th. Our one small mead of satisfaction was the running of A.E. Smith whose time on the Mitcham to Purley stage was third fastest.
